evidence.section: Full paper: Memory-Augmented Agents in Single Modality. Memory man-
evidence.paraphrase: SK-Gen abstracts experience into structured knowledge. For NS-Mem, this specifically supports abstraction of episodes into reusable experience of episodic, semantic and logic-rule layers.
SK-Gen incrementally updates neural and symbolic layers. For NS-Mem, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of episodic, semantic and logic-rule layers.

evidence.section: Full paper: Memory-Augmented Agents in Single Modality. Memory man-
evidence.paraphrase: Recurring experience is consolidated. For NS-Mem, this specifically supports merging or deduplication of overlapping entries of episodic, semantic and logic-rule layers.

Similarity-thresholded reinforcement increases or decreases symbolic edge weights, removing a relation when its accumulated weight reaches zero. For NS-Mem, this specifically supports evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence of episodic, semantic and logic-rule layers.

Exponential-moving-average updates revise goal and step index vectors as new experience is integrated. For NS-Mem, this specifically supports relinking or reindexing of stored items of episodic, semantic and logic-rule layers.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are explicitly linked for downstream retrieval, reasoning, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 2): During inference, the operative memory component (episodic, semantic and logic-rule layers) changes through abstraction of episodes into reusable experience, fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries, evidence-weighted revision of stored belief or confidence, relinking or reindexing of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
